Cegid Jasmin

Transform your business management with Cegid Jasmin!
POS Billing, Inventory, and Treasury, All in One Place.

Optimize your operations with integrated software that allows real-time control, saving time and increasing efficiency. Stay one step ahead, wherever you are.

Contact us

Jasmin Billing Software

Cegid Jasmin is a cloud management software designed to simplify and optimize business administration, especially for small and medium-sized enterprises.

This software provides you with the necessary tools to automate and simplify your business management.With an efficient billing system, it allows quick invoice issuance in compliance with legal standards.

Its multi-company management functionality enables control of several companies on a single platform, with shared and always accessible information.

Additionally, the software streamlines collections by integrating online payments into digital invoices, thus reducing collection times and automating receipt issuance.

With Cegid Jasmin’s Billing Program, your business has everything to flow naturally!

We offer 1 year free!

Use our cloud billing software for free up to €30,000 in billing or for 1 year.

Key Advantages

Cloud software

Access your information anywhere and on any device.

Efficiency

Easy to use, even for users without experience.

Legal compliance

Always up-to-date with current legislation.

Technical support

Specialized assistance to answer your questions.

Total control of your points of sale

Accelerate your sales process and manage multiple points of sale centrally and in real-time.

Primavera Jasmin is an easy-to-use point of sale system that allows you to manage multiple points of sale centrally. Compatible with the most popular point of sale hardware, it works online and offline.

  • Control of points of sale, in one place
  • Simplified management of items and prices
  • Online and offline POS billing

Primavera Jasmin: Integration with other Platforms and Applications

More than 1,000 applications are available, from Channel Manager, Booking Engine, Payment Gateway, Online Stores, CRM, and much more.

Billing in various currencies

With Primavera Jasmin, your business is global. Just choose the currency in which you want to bill.

Take advantage of this network and have your business fully integrated.

Features

Billing

Bill anytime, anywhere, and on any device.

Expenses

Photograph expense invoices for automatic processing.

Inventory

Integrated management of purchases, inventory, and multiple warehouses.

Treasury

Make faster collections and control current accounts.

Dashboard

Know your business's current and future performance.

Payments

Faster receipts with online payment options.

POS (Online and Offline)

Bill quickly and without problems at your points of sale.

Multichannel e-Commerce

Manage all e-commerce channels in one place.

Cegid Jasmin Support with specialized assistance

Get your questions answered by experts. We have a team always available to help.

Simply register Devlop as a Cegid Jasmin support partner on the Cegid portal, and you’ll automatically have 1 hour of support available for remote access and clarifications about the Jasmin billing software.

You can count on our Cegid Jasmin helpdesk team for software support, creation of custom reports, or more complex configurations.

Contact us and ask for Jasmin support.

Choose a plan that adapts to your Company and Employees

Contact us to help you choose the best solution of prices and features adapted to your business.
